audit.why: Difficulty 7.5/10 with a 51.2% Shen win rate over 3000 games fits a lane Shen survives rather than wins; the early is Darius's and the value is Stand United on the map.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart disagreed with the packet and with the already-audited mirror (darius__shen) in three rows: Level 3, Level 6 and 2+ items.
audit.why: Mirror findings record Levels 3 and 6 as Darius and 2+ items as Skill at 5/10. The packet chart also gives Darius the first five rows. Both layers (phases[N].side and win[N]) carried the wrong tokens, so the page rendered a chart contradicting its own whys.
audit.corrected: Level 3 -> Darius, Level 6 -> Darius, 2+ items -> Skill at 5/10, proposed as matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text repeatedly said W blocks 'his Decimate outer ring autos', blurring an ability with basic attacks, and never stated the decisive rule.
audit.why: Spirit's Refuge (W) blocks basic attacks only. Darius's autos and the Crippling Strike reset are eaten inside the zone; Decimate (Q) and Apprehend (E) land through it untouched. That single rule decides every trade in the lane and it is the same fact recorded on the mirror page.
audit.corrected: Stated explicitly in wants.you[0], phases[1].why and report[5].t, with Apprehend at 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s and Shadow Dash at 18/16/14/12/10s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grievous Wounds timing was named only once, late, though Decimate's outer-ring heal is what wins Darius the extended trade.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule 'needs-antiheal' applies to this matchup: Darius sustains through chip damage via Decimate.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal folded into whys[3] and the first-item spike.

audit.why: Packet flagged 'Use Stand United' as a probable wrong ability name; Stand United is Shen's real R in the kit file. False positive, no edit made.

edits.before: W spirit zone blanks his auto window. Only take the trade when Darius's Apprehend is down.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blanks his autos, not Decimate. Trade only when Apprehend is down — 26s at rank 1.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Darius must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but his level-3 damage is the highest in the lane. Hold the wave near you and taunt only to break his pull.

edits.before: His all-in start. E-taunt after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His only engage, 26s at rank 1. Shadow Dash in once it is spent, not before.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Shadow Dash spent early leaves you 18s with no answer to his pull.

edits.before: Track Darius's Apprehend (Pull): His all-in start. E-taunt after it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Apprehend, 26s at rank 1, is his only engage. Spirit's Refuge eats autos, not Decimate — trade after it.

edits.before: Use W to block his Decimate outer ring autos and deny Hemorrhage stacks
edits.after: Drop Spirit's Refuge to eat his autos — Decimate still lands through it

edits.before: Darius's Hemorrhage and Q heal sustain dominate extended trades through levels 4-5; without his Apprehend on cooldown you cannot safely commit Shadow Dash, so the lane stays in his favor.
edits.after: Decimate's outer ring heals him off every extended trade, so a Bramble Vest component lands before your second item; until Apprehend's 21s cooldown is spent you cannot commit Shadow Dash.

edits.before: Sunfire Aegis lets your E-taunt deal meaningful burn damage while W blocks the auto-attacks Darius needs to build bleed stacks, evening out extended trades.
edits.after: Sunfire Aegis plus Grievous Wounds is the real spike: Spirit's Refuge eats the autos that stack Hemorrhage, and anti-heal cuts the Decimate outer-ring healing.

notes: Packet defect 'Use Stand United' is a FALSE POSITIVE — Stand United is Shen's actual R name in the kit file; no edit made. Chart flips align this page with the already-audited mirror darius__shen (Levels 3 and 6 to Darius, 2+ items to Skill at 5/10) and with packet.levelChart; proposed as matched full/content pairs. Spell-shield/QSS/tenacity interactions for Apprehend and Shadow Dash are not in Riot's text and were not asserted.
